test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which statement of the following is not true regarding national highway?

options.text: NH-44 is the longest national highway of India.
NH-8 is the shortest national highway in India.
NH-47A is the shortest national highway in India.
NHAI has the authority for the development, maintenance and management of national highways

solution:
The correct answer is __**NH-8 is the shortest national highway in India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **NH-8**

 
 
• **National Highway 8 (NH 8) **is a National Highway in India running from Karimganj in Assam to Sabroom in Tripura.
 
• It is a **4-lane (6-lane in most parts) **National Highway in India.
 
• It connects the national capital Delhi to the financial capital Mumbai.
 
• The total length is **1428km.**
 
• It is popularly known as **Western Express Highway.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **NH-44**

 
 
• **National Highway 44 (NH 44)** is a major north–south National Highway in India.
 
• It is the** longest highway** in the country.
 
• It passes through the Union Territory of **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
 
 
• **NH-47A**
 
 
• NH-47A is the** shortest national highway** in India.
 
• It covers a distance of **6 km (3.7 mi)** between Kundannoor and Willingdon Island in Kochi, Kerala.
 
• It starts from the junction of **NH 47** at Kundannoor. 
 
 
 
• **NHAI**
 
 
• **​**The National Highways Authority of India or NHAI is an autonomous agency of the Government of India.
 
• It was set up in **1995 (Act 1988).**
 
• It is responsible for the management of a network of over** 50,000 km **of National Highways out of **1,32,499 km **in India.
 
• NHAI has the authority for the development, maintenance and management of national highways.
 
• It is a nodal agency of the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.**
